property_summary: For any caller address A and any target address T, when the reference C's setOwner(T) is invoked by A it succeeds iff A == C.owner(), so if it succeeds the contract's owner becomes T; the mutant inverts the guard so calls by the current owner are rejected and thus the owner does not update for those inputs (owner caller == current owner).
change_summary: Change the onlyOwner guard to require msg.sender != owner (inverse), making calls permitted only to non-owners.
